definitions.explanation: The period in polar regions in winter when the sun does not rise above the horizon for a day or more; the opposite of the midnight sun ({白夜|びゃくや}).

examples.japanese: ⟦{北極圏|ほっきょくけん}→北極圏：23417_hokkyokuken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{極夜|きょくや}。
examples.english: The polar night of the Arctic.

examples.japanese: {極夜|きょくや}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{間|あいだ}→間：00914_aida⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{一日中|いちにちじゅう}→一日中：09519_ichinichijuu⟧⟦{暗|くら}い→暗い：00647_kurai⟧。
examples.english: During the polar night it is dark all day.

examples.japanese: {極夜|きょくや}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{明|あ}けて→明ける：21288_akeru⟧⟦{久|ひさ}しぶり→久しぶり：01711_hisashiburi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{太陽|たいよう}→太陽：03398_taiyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{昇|のぼ}る→昇る：12960_noboru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人々|ひとびと}→人々：03141_hitobito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{集|あつ}まって→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧⟦{祝|いわ}う→祝う：01881_iwau⟧。
examples.english: When the polar night ends and the sun rises for the first time in weeks, the townspeople gather to celebrate.

notes:
From ⟦{極|きょく}→極：13150_kyoku⟧ (pole) + {夜|や} (night). A word of geography and travel writing.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{白夜|びゃくや}→白夜：32662_byakuya⟧: midnight sun, white night — the summer opposite, when the sun does not set
